pr_title: Implement key/value VFS storage with bounded run-length decoding
pr_description: Add key/value VFS encoding and database and journal storage operations. Decode zero runs using 64-bit length and multiplier values, rejecting lengths that exceed the output capacity during accumulation and checking the remaining space before writing.

fix_commit_message:
Fix a potential integer overflow when decoding a corrupt kvvfs block. Bug report [bugs:76acc88b57|2026-06-20T18:35:54Z].

FossilOrigin-Name: c36fc5df62c7eb8fca6a43cb0b3154a030b39a4cfade8fb04496120d4d339b97
agent_reasoning: The original decoder used 32-bit signed integers for the run length and base-26 multiplier, allowing corrupt encoded runs to overflow arithmetic and undermine the output bounds check. The supplied changes widen both values to sqlite3_int64 and reject oversized accumulated lengths before advancing the multiplier, retaining the final output bounds check. Applied to ext/misc/vfskv.c, the historical path of src/os_kv.c confirmed by git rename history. No test files or unrelated source were changed. Workspace validation passed against intro_parent.
